models.name: Classic
models.summary: A fixed-supply token with independent buy and sell fees, beneficiary-owned ETH rewards, optional initial-buy custody and permanently locked Uniswap v4 liquidity.

models.name: Stock-Paired
models.summary: A fixed-supply token paired with one reviewed tokenized stock or ETF quote asset, with quote-asset rewards and permanently locked Uniswap v4 launch liquidity.

models.name: Deep
models.summary: A proposed launch model that directs the creator fee share into add-only locked liquidity until an immutable target is reached.

models.name: First Mover
models.summary: Settles which pool owns a token symbol by trading volume rather than registration order
